result:
All 9 pipeline stages complete for `GET /internal/posts/{id}`.

**Analysis chain**: `getPost` → `CommunityService.getPost` → `PostRepository.findById(id)` on the `post` table (JPA). No interceptors/filters (`auth_type: none`), zero external HTTP calls anywhere in the dependency chain — so no WireMock stubs needed. RED param: `id` (PK, VARCHAR(64), DB_WHERE branch → `PostNotFoundException` → 404 problem+json).

**Generated (via spec → template-render, no hand-typed Java/SQL)**:
- `src/test/java/com/tainted/community/blackbox/InternalPostsGetByIdBlackBoxTest.java` — 9 tests: 3 NTC (distinct data incl. null `moodEmoji`, zero likes, and an exact-64-char boundary id), 1 ATC (404 not-found), 5 VTC (EMPTY, WHITE_SPACE, SPECIAL_CHAR, XSS, LENGTH_EXCEEDED on `id`)
- `src/test/resources/sql/internal-posts-get-by-id-{setup,teardown}.sql` — 3 self-contained fixture rows, parallel-safe (per-test-method deterministic IDs)
- `src/test/java/.../blackbox/support/BlackBoxSupport.java` — shared JDBC/RestAssured helper (project-wide, config-driven)

Two RED-rule cases were deliberately omitted with reasoning documented in the test class javadoc: `LENGTH_SHRUNK`/`INVALID_FORMAT` don't apply (no lower-bound or parse constraint on `id`), `NULL` collapses into the `EMPTY` case (this template ties one HTTP path per class to `{id}`, so omitting the segment entirely isn't distinguishable from sending an empty one), and a `WRONG_METHOD` tamper test was dropped since the renderer fixes one HTTP verb per class.

`template-usage.json` shows zero raw/custom fallback usage — everything was expressed in structured spec form. `validate-test-code` passed with no violations, and `manifest.json` records the endpoint as `status: "ok"` with all 4 generated files. Step 6 (execution/coverage) was intentionally not run per scope.
